features.quote: a rock face about 2 m high with cave openings

notes: s2f2: the caves are in the upper western part of the courtyard, which the entry puts 'in the lower eastern part of the site', so E from the site (Fig. 251, 0-10 m, shows 'Caves' inside courtyard 2, ~10 m east of the site centre). No pools or graves in the entry.
